dark.commentary:
Lumina Dawn, dark variant.
Warm sepia room lit by a single amber lamp; muted inks of rust, olive, sage, slate and plum at equal weight.

light.commentary:
Lumina Dawn, light variant.
Warm ivory paper under the same amber lamp; deep muted inks of rust, olive, sage, slate and plum at equal weight.

dark.commentary:
Lumina Tide, dark variant.
Deep ocean at night, lit from within by a single bioluminescent glow; sea-glass, kelp, slate blue and jellyfish violet at equal weight, coral and sand as rare warm notes.

light.commentary:
Lumina Tide, light variant.
Sea-foam paper under the same bioluminescent glow; deep inks of ocean blue, kelp, violet and coral at equal weight.

dark.commentary:
Lumina Canopy, dark variant.
A pine forest at noon: a single shaft of leaf-filtered sun, chartreuse gold, pierces the canopy. Chlorophyll, pine, russet and heather at equal weight in the shade, bark-brown strings.

light.commentary:
Lumina Canopy, light variant.
Leaf-tinted paper under the same shaft of sun; deep inks of chlorophyll, pine, russet and heather at equal weight.

dark.commentary:
Lumina Slate, dark variant.
Cold graphite ground; near-achromatic text and strings, one steel-blue lamp, steel cyan, muted violet, teal and sage at equal weight, a single warm note of brass in numbers.

light.commentary:

Lumina Oxblood, dark variant.
